messages:
Maya (marketing): Quick sync 14 I sketched a lightweight launch wireframe for the benchmark narrative. Goal: two short blog posts + one 30min webinar. Main hook = 'How to get 3x lower per-token cost at parity latency'.

Dan R: Nice. Can we surface a single clear chart on the landing that lands that claim? Something scannable for execs.

Priya S.: Agree. My thought: hero = scatter with iso-cost contours (latency on x, cost on y), then a 3-panel below: 1) avg latency vs cost, 2) tail latency comparison, 3) throughput/unit-dollar.

Alex - growth: Love the iso-contours idea. For inbound routing: if a lead clicks "enterprise" CTA, route to AE queue; "prototype" CTA -> product demo nurture. Can we add a hidden UTM for bench vs webinar flows?

Maya (marketing): Yup. Routing rules draft: 
- utm=bench-enterprise -> sales-queue A (AE priority)
- utm=bench-startup -> marketing-nurture list
- webinar-signup -> webinar->nurture->post-demo sequence
(we'll keep short form answers in the signup)

Oliver (data): For the charts I can produce three small svg outputs: scatter + contour, tail-latency violin, and tokens-per-dollar bar. Ill use the real benchmark set but add an anonymized customer example for storytelling. ETA tomorrow.

Anne (design): Will create a hero treatment that reduces cognitive load: single stat badge ("Up to 3x cost savings") + small interactive scatter hover. Also designing two CTA buttons (Enterprise / Get started).

Dan R: Webinar plan 1 30 minutes: 10m problem framing, 10m demo of tradeoffs (live chart walkthrough), 10m Q&A. Who will present the demo?

Priya S.: I can handle framing + moderation. Oliver can do the demo (data + charts). Maya will do the product tie-in and CTA.

Maya (marketing): Copy hooks I'm trying: 
- Headline: "Pay less for the same speed: benchmarks that matter"
- Subhead: "See real workloads where smart serving reduces cost without slowing users."

Alex - growth: For traffic, we'll run two promos: community email + targeted LinkedIn to infra/ML roles. Feed top-of-funnel leads into bench-startup, and higher intent clicks into bench-enterprise.

Anne (design): Quick accessibility check: the contour colors will be colorblind-safe palette, and I'll add high-contrast outlines for iso-lines.

Oliver (data): Quick note on claims: Ill produce a short methods blurb we can show (dataset, seq lengths, batching config). We'll include a small reproducibility snippet: 
```
# sample run command
rcli run --model redwood-v1 --seq 512 --batch 8 --quant q4
```

Maya (marketing): Tasks:
- Oliver: charts + methods blurb (ETA 24h)
- Anne: hero mock + CTA variants (ETA 48h)
- Priya: webinar script outline (ETA 48h)
- Alex: promo plan + utm mapping (ETA 24h)
- Dan: sign-off on claims/legal check (ETA 48h)

Dan R: Ill loop in legal now. Also can we add one micro-CTA for "Request a cost analysis" that pings AE with the lead details?

Maya (marketing): Good call. Add to routing: request-cost -> sales-queue B + high-touch flag.

deploy-bot: Webinar event created: https://events.example.com/redwood-bench-2026 (registration page live)

Priya S.: I'll draft attendee questions to surface common objections (data privacy, accuracy, SLA).

Maya (marketing): This thread looks healthy. If everyone hits ETAs we'll aim for blog + webinar live in 7 days. Ping here with any blockers. :thumbsup:

Oliver (data): One blocker: need final model list from runtime team to annotate chart legend. If not available, I'll include anonymized labels.

Maya (marketing): Noted  @Dan R can you ask runtime for the final list?

Dan R: On it. I'll update before noon tomorrow.

Anne (design): Small ask  can we get a screenshot of the console latency breakdown for the blog? visual helps.

Maya (marketing): I'll request a 2-slide export from Console and drop it here when ready.

Alex - growth: For measurement, we'll A/B hero CTA (Enterprise vs Get started) and track demo signups and MQL rate. Will set up segments.

Priya S.: Great. I'll prepare 3 Q&A canned answers for the webinar.

Maya (marketing): Thanks team  follow ups in separate threads if needed.
